title: Permission Protocol receipt, signed payload (receiptVersion 2, jcs_v2)
description: The JSON object obtained by decoding a receipt's signed payload bytes (artifact.payload_bytes_b64). This is exactly what the Ed25519 signature covers, after SHA-256. Field names equal the hosted service's stored column names. Fields whose stored value is null are absent from the payload, never present as null. See SPEC.md.

id.description: Receipt identifier, unique per issuer. Deploy-gate receipts use rcpt_dg_<requestId>; execute-lane receipts use the row's generated id.

companyId.description: Issuer-side tenant identifier. Opaque to verifiers.

idemKey.description: Idempotency key. Execute lane: the caller's idempotencyKey or, by default, the inputHash. Deploy gate: deploy-gate:<requestId>:<scopeHash>. Unique per (companyId, idemKey).

agentId.description: The acting agent as supplied by the caller. The deploy-gate lane always writes github-actions.

runId.description: Optional run or session identifier supplied by the caller. Absent when not supplied.

requestJson.description: The action snapshot as a JSON text with recursively sorted keys. A string, not an object: the bytes are stored and signed as text. Verifiers that inspect it MUST parse it and MUST treat its contents as scope evidence, not as authenticated fields beyond the string itself.

inputHash.description: Execute lane: sha256:<hex> over the canonical hashable request (pp.hashable_payload.v1). Deploy gate: the bare hex scope hash over env, repo, ref, commit, capability, workflow, artifact digest.

status.description: The decision. Only decisions are signed; pending holds, EXPIRED and ERROR rows carry no signature and are not receipts under this specification.

riskTier.description: Execute-lane risk tier. Absent on deploy-gate receipts.

policyVersion.description: The policy version that governed the decision. deploy-gate-v1 on the deploy-gate lane; the router's policy version, or <ruleId>@<ruleVersion> for a scoped intake rule, on the execute lane.

reasonCodes.description: A JSON array of reason-code strings, serialized as text. Order is preserved. Parse before use.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the decision context.

deciderId.description: Stable identifier of who decided. user:<id> a session-authenticated human; api_key:<id> a machine credential; demo:<id> an anonymous demo signer; system/* the deterministic policy engine at a named mint path; role/* a role class on the execute lane.

deciderDisplay.description: Human-facing label for the decider: a GitHub login for a session signer, a fixed engine label for policy decisions, a role-class label for role/* deciders.

deciderAuthMethod.description: Credential lane of the decider. Absent when the mint path recorded null (the webhook auto-clearance path, deciderId system/pp-engine).

resolutionType.description: How a hold was resolved. Absent on policy-engine decisions on the execute and ledger lanes (the engine cleared or denied under policy; it did not allow once).

attributionConfidence.description: How strongly the decision is tied to the decider. credentialed: authenticated principal or named policy version. heuristic: identity joined at signing time rather than captured at the signature. unattributed: anonymous (demo scope only; production fails closed).

scope.description: A demo receipt is signed under a distinct demo key and can never pass as production evidence.

receiptVersion.description: Integer 2 for this document. The v1 fixtures in this repository carry the string "v1"; the hosted service has always stored an integer.

signatureKeyId.description: Identifies the issuer key. Resolve through the published key set before verifying.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds (Date.prototype.toISOString). Expiry bounds one-time redemption of an approval; the signature stays valid evidence after expiry.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. The moment the receipt row was created; for decision receipts signed at decision time this is when the decision landed.
